name: Dead Tide VII: La Isla de las Hadas
source:
In this exciting chapter of the Dead Tide saga, the Dread Pirate Queen Jessenia brings her ship the Black Pearl Necklace to the fabled Island of the Faeries. While Ariella the former mermaid (now Mer-Slut) and Gibonotik (a reanimated skeleton) explore the finer points of pornographic literature, Jessenia has need of an audience with the Faerie royals of the island, and sends Ariella and Gibonotik ashore to seek out and retrieve the reclusive King and Queen of the Faerie-Kingdom.

But this island is not ruled by the Fae-Folk alone. The Faerie King has dangerous enemies who must be vanquished before he dares leave his realm, and Gibonoitk and Ariella are just the type of expendable nobodies he needs to get the job done!

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-vii.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
在死潮传奇的激动人心的一章中，恐惧海盗女王杰西尼亚带着她的船黑珍珠项链来到了传说中的精灵岛。当前美人鱼阿里埃拉（现为梅尔荡妇）和吉博诺蒂克（复活的骷髅）探索色情文学的精髓时，杰西尼亚需要觐见岛上的精灵王室成员，于是派阿里埃拉和吉博诺蒂克上岸寻找并找回隐居的精灵王国国王和王后。

但这座岛屿并非仅由精灵族统治。精灵王有危险的敌人，在他敢于离开他的王国之前必须将他们击败，而吉博诺伊特克和阿里埃拉正是他完成任务所需要的那种可以牺牲的无名小卒！
